messages:
Maya Chen: quick question — small docs PR to add an example for toggling region endpoints in the JS SDK. Also need a short data-residency note. Who can review?
Javier Morales: I can take a look. Is this for the new region-preferred config or the old useEU flag?
Maya Chen: new config. we introduced regionPreferred/fallbackRegion in runtime v1.8. want code sample showing preferred->fallback behavior + mention that useEU is deprecated
Priya Singh: wording suggestion for the note: "Requests routed to a customer's preferred region will attempt the primary region first; if capacity is unavailable, requests may be routed to a compatible region. Data residency is preserved for customer-managed Private deployments; for hosted, see the residency table below." Short and non-legal. :+1:
Javier Morales: here's a quick snippet for the JS SDK — pls check formatting

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, regionPreferred: 'eu-west-1', fallbackRegion: 'us-west-2' });

const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'Summarize the meeting' });
console.log(res.text);
```

Javier Morales: also add a one-line note under the snippet: "If you rely on strict EU-only residency, use Private deployments or the EU-only Hosted offering — see residency matrix." link to matrix
Sam O'Neill: SDk test matrix link: https://go.redwood.ai/residency-matrix — add as inline link
Maya Chen: thanks! can someone make a tiny migration blurb: "If you previously used `useEU: true`, migrate to `regionPreferred: 'eu-*'` — the old flag will be removed in v1.10". keep single sentence
Priya Singh: +1. also flag the PR to docs-review board, tag legal for residency line? maybe not legal unless claims about guarantees. keep it advisory
Sam O'Neill: i'll open the PR and add reviewers @javier @priya. PR will include test snippet under "SDK samples" and a redirect from old snippet path
Sam O'Neill: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4592
Maya Chen: awesome — added the link; leaving it to you for final wording. thx :rocket:
docs-bot: JIRA RDOC-821 created for follow-up to update SDK changelog and deprecation note
Javier Morales: i'll review this afternoon and leave small edits. sound good?
Maya Chen: perfect, will merge after approvals. thanks team :sparkles:
